title: Pure discovered chase: every chasing move is a discovery and the target never moves
rationale: The white horse shuttles c5/d3 and never attacks d5 itself; each of its moves unblocks one white chariot onto the unprotected black cannon on d5 while blocking the other, so a5 renews the attack along rank 5 after c5d3 and d1 renews it along the d-file after d3c5, while the target and the black general never move. A chase is judged by the threat the move produces rather than by which piece moved, and one target chased by several pieces is one chase, so the chasing side (Red) loses at the third occurrence.
